description: This file defines a client-side React component for displaying a detailed shop overview page, including fetching shop data, handling loading and error states, and providing navigation to related sections like invoices, customers, and payments.

methods.name: fetchShop
methods.description: Fetches shop details from API based on URL parameter, updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: onCopyId
methods.description: Copies the shop ID to clipboard and shows a success or error toast.

methods.name: onSetActive
methods.description: Sets the current shop as active in the context and shows a confirmation toast.
